reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is byte-identical to the originals with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: § 4.1 (p0052) ties Charges solely to Services specified in Service Option Attachments/Order Forms (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), with no minimum, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic.
p0142 (Capacity Planning) allocates sizing responsibility to Customer but imposes no usage floor or volume cap, so it is correctly read as out of scope for MINCOMMIT.

Exit right is corroborated: p0044/p0046 give Customer termination for convenience at month end, with early termination charges only 'if any' in Attachment A / Service Option Attachments; the rationale properly flags those documents (and Order Forms) for pre-signature review rather than overstating compliance.
No deterministic check failures; nothing in the supplied paragraphs indicates a deviation requiring an actionable edit.
